findings: The real ScrapeView keeps pane selection outside the active-page-gated Tabs subtree and binds it to originalCapture object identity. Returning to the same capture restores Video; a new setCurrent capture changes originalCapture and selects Article.
The existing pageKey equality gate still hides captured results while another page or an unresolved tab is active.

The guard uses the real ScrapeView, scrape store, and design-system Tabs. It checks Video after null and different page identities, second-video Copy, stale-page hiding, and Article after a new capture. It does not exercise browser tab activation or native pointer behavior.

The old native receipt for run 37215748629 has a trusted Open click at 8695 ms, disconnected result tabs at 8743 ms, and Article selected before the failed second-video Copy at 9094 ms. This supports the diagnosed boundary but predates the fix.
